prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Make ONE genuinely new full-body production game miniature, 2:3 portrait RGBA transparent, not a recolor or cutout of references. Prominent circular industrial roller emblem on chest: straight HORIZONTAL silver central band, parallel row of round steel roller ends above and row below (NOT radial wheel, spokes, petals, flower, GA hexagon or PO flame). Warm key light on metal ONLY, subtle cool edge reflection, polished face with finely textured steel clothing. Isolated character, clean alpha=0 exterior and body gaps; no aura/glow/fog/background/floor/shadow/pedestal. Head, fingertips and soles entirely inside canvas, figure about 82% height, generous equipment room. No text, letters, numerals, logos, watermark, stars, SSR, ATK, weapons or additional props. ID ssial-1470M. Martensitic cold-formed rigid grade: low faceted polygon steel helmet enclosing silver rounded rectangular face, dark desaturated blue-grey monolithic angular torso, hard flat bevel edges, long rigid segmented arms and blocky feet. Fine uniform acicular brushed steel texture, few rivets, NO horns and no tall ridge, no flexible coat. Small calm dark-blue low eyes and short straight mouth. Circular steel roller emblem remains round on angular chest. New stance one leg slightly advanced, arms down clear of chest. Material rigidity not combat power.
